A-anvil.refinement: Independent reconstruction. Widened and offset the foot, lifted and blunted the horn, shortened the striking block and heel, and matched the restrained iron value. Remaining differences are bevels, smooth-normal shading and the waist transition. No cache mesh was imported.

B-riveter.refinement: Original split-die riveting station. The open die slot, long bending horn, forged clamps and low timber bolster define its construction. Refinement reduced the timber saturation and added a seated rivet and hammer to explain use.

C-stamp.refinement: Original counterweighted screw press. Refinement connected the lever to the spindle, modeled a real helical thread and added guide springs and a billet. The first pass left the transmission unclear; the final load path reads through the open throat.

D-sootsnout.refinement: Original Sootsnout ash burrower. Broadened the forepaws, thickened the forelegs, replaced peg-like ears with swept wedges and subdued the dorsal plates. Attack coils back with an open jaw before striking and recovering. Death folds the legs before the roll and holds the corpse.

contact_diagnostics.limitations: Contact and support are explicit geometric proxies. No inferred mass, physical collision, automatic artistic approval or time warp. World travel is stated, not fitted to minimize slip.

limitations: Silhouette overlap measures registration, not complete artistic fidelity. Bevel and shading differences remain.
Original assets use sparse face colors and native directional lighting, no textures or emitted light.
Creature paws and material transitions remain angular. Walk contact shows small quantized drift, not verified physical locomotion.
No gameplay integration, pathfinding, NPC combat, roof or occlusion work.
